ACCOMPLISHMENTS
Led a cross-functional KYC transformation programme migrating the Periodic Review process from Singapore to Pune, improving operational efficiency while ensuring delivery governance and regulatory compliance.
Designed and implemented a centralized outreach model for Agent/Indirect Principal and same-group relationships, reducing review turnaround time by 5 days and improving client experience.
Partnered with Compliance, Front Office and Technology teams to implement workflow improvements and reliance-based review methodology, strengthening governance and operational efficiency.
Supported workforce optimisation initiatives contributing to 10% contractor-to-FTE conversion aligned with long-term business strategy and cost optimisation.
Enabled 60% FTE growth through structured governance, delivery excellence and stakeholder confidence.
Led transition and operational readiness of the Trade Confirmation process from a third-party vendor, ensuring successful stabilisation and governance.
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Assistant Vice President, APAC, UK/US KYC Operations
Credit Suisse India Services Pvt. Ltd | Pune, India | Dec 2019 – Feb 2026
Led APAC Periodic Review operations managing 34+ FTEs across Private Banking and Institutional portfolios, driving programme governance, operational excellence and regulatory compliance.

Led governance of adverse media reviews, regulatory escalations and financial crime risk assessments across high-risk client populations.
Implemented enhanced control frameworks across maker-checker-reviewer processes resulting in zero audit findings for three consecutive years.
Managed critical regulatory escalations, remediation workstreams and client risk reviews ensuring timely resolution.
Partnered with Technology, Compliance and Operations teams to deliver workflow automation and process enhancement initiatives.
Managed strategic KYC platform migration and operational readiness activities supporting business transformation.

Team Manager, APAC KYC Operations
J.P. Morgan India Services Pvt. Ltd | Bangalore, India | Dec 2017 - Dec 2019
Managed APAC periodic review governance, ensuring adherence to regulatory deadlines, service-level expectations, quality standards, and operational risk controls.

Partnered with Front Office and Compliance teams to resolve documentation gaps, risk classification issues, and review closure dependencies.
Implemented population scoping and prioritization models to balance workload based on risk rating, regulatory urgency, and delivery timelines.
Team Leader, APAC + EMEA + US KYC Operations

Supported cross-regional coordination to manage workload allocation, delivery timelines, and process adherence across global teams.
